rv.q: There is a significant lack of fizz between them which undercuts the love story and subsequent betrayals. Winston’s sadistic superior, O’Brien (Keith Allen), played by Richard Burton in the film, has a more active role in Winston’s entrapment here.
Beware the great adaptations, that production, which took 1984 and spun it out in surprising and novel ways, sits as a heavy albatross around the neck of this new reworking from Ryan Craig.
Anniversary staging of George Orwell’s classic is visually striking, but emotionally unengaging
